title: London’s water supply and the introduction of sand filtration (Chelsea)
lineage: Paraphrased historical research notes on inspected passages, not a reproduction of the source.

passages.note: The institutional history reports James Simpson’s sand-filtration scheme at the Chelsea Waterworks by 1829 and says it supplied Chelsea residents. It identifies an earlier Scottish industrial experiment as an antecedent. The source makes a broad priority claim that this record does not adopt.
